Обратимые компоненты плана можно изменить или отменить без значительных последствий, тогда как необратимые приводят к постоянным изменениям или потерям ресурсов.

memory_proposal.text: The distinction between reversible and irreversible plan components is material for evaluating plans. Reversible components can be undone or altered without lasting consequence, while irreversible components, once executed, cannot be undone or easily reversed, often carrying permanent or high-cost consequences.
memory_proposal.grounds: This distinction is directly requested by the user and is a recurring analytical pattern in planning and evaluation tasks. Its utility lies in risk assessment, flexibility analysis, and decision-making under uncertainty.
